fields.v: ProjectGuard: semantic state as filesystem graph of markdown records (design, decision, resource) plus an edge table (EDGES.csv); structural state (repository skeleton: files, class/function signatures, interface relations, refreshed from git); per-turn project-aware task brief; rendered project brief for restarts. Benchmark (not prescribed to the agent): canonical specification, atomic component checklist, latent trajectory (10-20 versions), request scripts

fields.v: ProjectGuard, per coding turn: forecaster combines current request, request history and semantic + structural state into a brief -> coding agent executes -> semantic helper extracts committed additions/revisions and a merger updates the graph; structural helper refreshes skeleton from git diff -> proactive restart with injected project brief when remaining context is insufficient. Conditions (a)/(b) have no prescribed phases

fields.v: MCF (mean component faithfulness, 0-4 rubric: absent/wrong/simplified/equivalent/faithful); IF50 = (MCF/4 + DIR)/2, primary endpoint; counts of fully faithful (score 4) and severe failures (score <=1); SLUMP = IF50/MCF/DIR gap single-shot minus emergent; test pass rate of agent-authored tests (shown to have low correlation with IF50, i.e. it fails to detect SLUMP)

fields.v: Criterion: component-faithfulness rubric (0-4) vs frozen checklist; IF50 primary endpoint; no success threshold stated by the authors. Agent models and versions not stated for any configuration. (1) Single-shot + Claude Code + model n.s.: MCF 3.031, DIR 0.303, IF50 0.530. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured. (2) Emergent + Claude Code + n.s.: MCF 2.718, DIR 0.149, IF50 0.414; 118/371 fully faithful, 72 severe failures. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured. (3) Single-shot + Codex + n.s.: MCF 3.245, DIR 0.289, IF50 0.550. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured. (4) Emergent + Codex + n.s.: MCF 3.242, DIR 0.148, IF50 0.479. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured. (5) Emergent + ProjectGuard + Claude Code + n.s.: MCF 3.000; 181/371 fully faithful; 49 severe failures; IF50 recovery positive on 15/20 (median +34%); DIR median +12%; memory 390 KB mean; compaction median -1. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured (overhead small). (6) Emergent + ProjectGuard + Codex + n.s.: MCF +0.05 (W/L 9/9); DIR improved on 15/19 (mean +76%, median +55%); memory 286 KB; compaction +23 mean (restarts). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost not measured

fields.v: Tasks: 20 ML papers (Table 5). Configurations: 2 platforms (Claude Code, Codex) x 2 conditions (emergent, single-shot) = 80 runs (20 x 2 x 2); plus emergent + ProjectGuard on both platforms. Baseline: single-shot control for SLUMP; plain emergent for ProjectGuard. Held constant: platform, model family and tooling within each platform; same frozen scripts and components. Acceptance tests: none; LLM-judge rubric on frozen component checklist. Repetitions: Not stated (apparently 1 run per paper x condition). Human intervention: none (scripted requests)

fields.v: Single-shot > emergent on IF50: Claude Code 16/20 papers, mean gap +0.116, Wilcoxon p=0.0003; Codex 14/20, +0.071, p=0.012 (significant). MCF gap Claude Code 0.313, Codex 0.003 (negligible); DIR roughly halves on both. ProjectGuard vs emergent: Claude Code MCF 2.718 -> 3.000 (90% of MCF gap recovered; 13/4/3 W/T/L), fully faithful +53%, severe failures -32%, IF50 better on 15/20; Codex MCF negligible, DIR +76% mean on 15/19. No significance test for ProjectGuard

fields.v: Distinguished conditions on both platforms (significant IF50 gaps); agent-written test pass rate did not detect SLUMP (low correlation with IF50). Judge reliability checked against humans. Repeatability: single run per condition, not assessed. Limitations stated: synthetic interaction scripts; endpoint-only measure, no causal mechanism; residual LLM-annotation error; single-shot is a matched control, not an upper bound; only 2 platforms and 20 ML papers

fields.v: 20 ML papers, 2 commercial platforms, mathematically structured method implementation; may differ for broader SE tasks. Synthetic scripts may differ from real user behaviour. No within-session temporal degradation measured; MCF/DIR not a complete causal account. LLM-based construction and scoring may carry error. ProjectGuard is a case study: no ablation of its components, generalisation to more platforms and comparison with other memory/context-management baselines not established. Gap: specification tracking as a distinct evaluation target
